readerQuestion: Could neighbours lose a guaranteed chance to comment on the air permit for a nearby data centre?

sources.readScope: PDF pages6-7 substantive proposal and preserved requirements; earlier page0/definitions checked in recovery record
passages: If this rule is finalized as proposed, State and local air agencies would be allowed to, but would not be required to, revise their existing SIP-approved minor NSR program public participation requirements through the SIP submission and approval process (SIP process).

If an air agency chooses not to revise its minor NSR program’s existing public participation requirements in response to a final version of this proposed rule, those existing minor NSR public participation requirements would remain in the SIP and continue to apply to minor sources and minor modifications regulated by the air agency within its jurisdiction.

The EPA further notes that any amendments to SIPs pursued as a result of this action would, if finalized, involve mandatory opportunities for public participation both at the State and local level and during the Agency review process

The EPA is not proposing to revise the minimum Federal public participation requirements that apply to the permitting of new major sources or major modifications to existing sources under air agencies’ major NSR programs.
sources.scope: July7 proposal; not finalized in checked records. State implementation plans (SIPs) can retain existing participation; changes still undergo public participation and EPA review. Major permitting and specified other programs unaffected. Do not say the proposal already silenced residents.

passages: In April 2026, Amazon submitted to DEP a plan approval application for the installation of 280 natural gas-fired generator engines and three diesel-fired emergency generator engines. These generator engines will only provide backup electricity to the data center in the event of a main utility power supply interruption and for other limited testing and maintenance purposes.

The public comment period on DEP’s proposed decision on the air quality Minor New Source Plan Approval Application No. 09-0261A will be open for 30 days after publication in the Pennsylvania Bulletin.
sources.scope: Concrete historical example: backup generators at Amazon data centre, Falls Township Bucks County. Do not describe all283 engines as diesel. July14 meeting and July expected comment window are past, not current invitations. This does not establish that Pennsylvania has removed any current public rights.

sources.observed: EPA identifies stationary turbines/engines as common primary or backup data-centre power, subject to emission standards.
